scope_notes.label: Model proposal, later regional observations and editorial reach
scope_notes.source_locator: Author-hosted abstract: previously unknown current east of Solomon Sea formed where SEC meets Solomon Islands; named Solomon Islands Coastal Undercurrent.
scope_notes.summary: The 2010 model proposes SICU east of the Solomon Islands. A pinned 2017 primary paper interprets northward flow near northeast Bougainville, with ADCP and tracer station context. OSW adds an offshore geographic reference reach; continuous measured axis, complete endpoints, width and annual ranges remain unresolved.
